d: We are looking for a Sales Executive to join our team and be part of our growth. You will be responsible for onboarding new restaurant partners to the platform, managing the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals, expanding our network, and driving growth in your assigned region.
Identify and acquire new restaurant and retail partners through field sales, cold calling, and networking
Generate and qualify leads through research, outreach, referrals, and market mapping to build a strong sales pipeline
Present talabat’s value proposition and negotiate commercial agreements
Onboard new partners and ensure a smooth integration into the platform
Maintain strong relationships with partners to drive long-term collaboration
Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs
Conduct market research to identify new opportunities and competitive insights
Collaborate with internal teams (account management, marketing, operations) to ensure partner success
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in field sales, preferably in e-commerce, FMCG, or technology startups.
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems is a plus (e.g., Salesforce).
A valid driving license is a must
